purpose: Freeze an interpretable multi-axis measurement and test operational consistency before full-corpus replacement.
exclude: All documented exclusions used for v4 plus all 160 v4 pilot texts; earlier whole-corpus model exposure remains disclosed.
comparison: Within the same new sample, compare historical v2 and v3 positive coverage; do not infer full-corpus v5 coverage or compare unmatched v4/v5 agreement as an improvement estimate.

consistency_screen.scope: Random partition only; a screening convention, not a validity certificate or accuracy estimate
consistency_screen.insufficient_positive_support: Keep as descriptive candidate; do not call failed or validated. Review targeted diagnostics separately.

regression_design.primary: Jointly enter supported expression parents only, with existing text/media controls and author/date fixed effects; omit conditional attributes.
regression_design.topic_adjusted: On its own common sample add supported topic indicators; compare primary expression design on exactly the same sample before interpreting coefficient changes.
regression_design.polarity: Within EXPERIENCE or APPRAISAL positive texts and both polarity attributes known, compare supported positive-only, negative-only, mixed and neither categories, omit one reference; report the conditional population and unknowns.
regression_design.other_attributes: Plan/goal and greeting/thanks are conditional descriptive or supported secondary comparisons, never a full set of parent plus exhaustive child dummies.
regression_design.unknowns: Remain missing per variable; structural not-applicable stays separate; no blanket zero-imputation.
regression_design.inference: log(1+likes), author-clustered uncertainty, BH within predeclared expression or conditional test family; all analyses remain retrospective exploratory, no causal interpretation.
regression_design.topic_weights: Preserve earlier NMF model as historical continuous-weight analysis: weights sum to one, omit one component with an intercept; do not replace with dominant-topic dummies.
regression_design.collinearity: Check rank and full-design VIF on each actual joint sample. VIF>=5 triggers diagnosis, not automatic deletion or merging of semantically different variables. Exclude constant or exactly redundant columns and disclose it.

pilot_diagnostics: Outcome-blind agreement, variable availability, common-sample attrition, multi-label overlap, and expression-only numerical design checks; pilot checks are not full-corpus fixed-effect VIF or likes regressions.
adoption: Complete new pilot and provide executable full-corpus handoff; no claim that all 5414 posts have been relabeled. Production classification and independent human review remain explicit future work.
